card.name: Words just before tax or revenue
card.fires_on: Small words and short terms in government finance text where the next word is likely to be about collecting taxes or revenue, such as "generate more" or "collected their own".

modes.label: Linking words before taxes
modes.description: A small word like more, own, and or be sits right before an expected tax or revenue word.

modes.label: Inside fiscal phrases
modes.description: Words like tax, GDP, or Security within talk of government funding, right before collection or revenue terms.
modes.example: allocation of<< tax>> receipts among the various county projects

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about levying and collecting tax and revenue, including Chinese forms of those words.
card.plain: It fires on words that come just before an expected mention of taxes being collected or revenue being raised.
